assessments.reasoning: Clause 8.22.1 defines the scope as assignment and actual-to-formal association. Clause 8.22.6 uses the first applicable branch. The reference-semantics branch attaches the target to that same object after excluding conversion, void and copy-semantics branches.

challenge.method: Read all four branches and the definition of attachment. Test competing conversion and copy-semantics cases and separate abstract effect from an implementation sequence.
challenge.results: Where the valid reference-semantics case applies without conversion, attachment is to the existing object. Void and copy-semantics cases have separate effects.

limitations: The result is the normative abstract effect under the stated condition. Internal representation and clone strategies are unverified.
